The Salt Hounds raided from the west under Mirel Dask. Hale was shot dead at the barricade; Dee led the funeral for her brother.
Cy and Mara were married in the yard with Dee officiating, while Kit watched from the back and left before the vows.
Raiders of the Ashen Fang were driven off at the east gate; Kit was cut and Dee tended her.

text: He always worried about the straight lines, friend, I hope he finds some peace now.

context.speaker: Ana
speaker_knows: Old Odo died in the rice field this morning; I held his hand and he asked whether the rows were straight.
Hale was shot dead at the barricade and Tam saw it from the door.
Bram took the spare rifle at night and thinks nobody saw.

text: Enough. Hale was tough.

context.speaker: Dee
speaker_knows: My brother Hale was shot down in the raid, and I could not reach him in time.
Old Odo died beside his rice and I sat with him until the light came.
Cy and Kit came to blows and I stitched Kit's hand afterwards.

text: I vow to share every meal and every sunrise with you, Mara; we'll see.

context.speaker: Cy
speaker_knows: Mara and I are to be married tonight, with Dee officiating.
Kit and I fought in the courtyard over the rifle; she split my lip.
I called Kit a coward in front of Dee and Tam and I would do it again.

text: I promise to stand by you, Cy, through every dust storm we face.

context.speaker: Mara
speaker_knows: Cy and I will be married tonight, and I want it done before the weather turns.
Cy came back from the courtyard with a split lip and would not say who.
